Before the review, settle whether the 0.5 bar is relative or absolute, and check the segment inconsistency. Latency p95 +3.1% (+12.8 ms) against a 2% margin. The SSR gain is uncorroborated: CTR, Long Click Rate and Clicks per User are flat. The document also flags that the segment SSR results (negative in both Mobile and Desktop, positive overall) can't all be right, so segment numbers shouldn't be quoted yet.

Before the review, settle whether the 0.5 bar is relative or absolute, and check the segment inconsistency.
